question: What residual moisture did the NMP- and the water-processed NMC532 cathodes contain at 20 °C?
rendered: According to the text, the NMP-processed NMC532 cathode contained 200 ppm of residual moisture at 20 °C, while the water-based one contained 625 ppm of residual moisture at 20 °C.
